name: Chickpea and Tofu Breakfast Sandwich
ingredients: ½ cup cooked chickpeas, lightly mashed
steps: Toast bread lightly. Pat tofu dry and crumble.
Heat oil in a skillet. Add onion and tomato; cook 2–3 minutes.
Add chickpeas, tofu, paprika, cumin and pepper. Mash some chickpeas as the mixture warms.
Cook 4–5 minutes until the filling is hot and holds together; finish with lemon and coriander.
Divide filling between toast slices, close the sandwiches and serve.
note: Check bread ingredients for dairy or honey if keeping the meal vegan.
